title: nepeta podostachys var. paulsenii
intro: Nepeta podostachys var. paulsenii, commonly known as Catmint, is a perennial herb belonging to the mint family. It has been traditionally used for its potential health benefits, including aiding in digestion and relieving stress. The therapeutic actions of Nepeta podostachys var. paulsenii are attributed to its sedative, antispasmodic, and ant-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include rosmarinic acid, nepetalactone, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
